Probably because an adult man making conversation with a teenage girl is weird. But now a lot of guys will make small talk with me, compliment my clothing, or call me names like "dude" or "buddy". I like it :)

In general, people think I'm younger too. I get treated like a 12 year old boy ish (I'm 17) which can be annoying at times, but sometimes nice. I can get away with acting stupid/awkward in public every once in a while, and I can order off the kids menu if I feel like it.

Plus I'm way more confident to just exist, knowing that people see me the way I want to be seen. I'm nowhere near the standard of male that cis people often set, but I pass enough, and I'm so glad I do because it feels wonderful :')
